snippet.title: AETHUS - Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
AETHUS is a story-driven survival game with a low-poly isometric style and deep, systemic gameplay.

Explore a futuristic sci-fi underground world to mine and prospect for the valuable resources you need to build up your mining colony, while navigating a rich story of dystopian ultra-capitalism as you attempt to escape the grasp of your mega-corporation former employers.

Wishlist now on Steam!: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541530/AETHUS/?utm_source=youtubetrailer

Sign up for our Kickstarter pre-launch page to be notified when we go live!:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pawsmonautgames/meridian-game

Join our Discord community!
https://discord.gg/9pJwcuAhDU

Original soundtrack composed by  @madisonjamessmithmusic3641
